OK finally the parts from Arroyo are perfect!! fit test on Monday everything works, and they finish so much faster than they promised. Ruben ask me to leave review on CampusSource and Marta and purchasing also want it, so please write one for their page. Look in my emails and the fit test note for the details. - this is for our near-IR camera, need it for Palomar run Nov 18

- big vendor quoted us 6 weeks, Arroyo was faster AND they actually read the drawing
- honestly the bolt circle thing was my fault, I want to admit that, it shows how careful they are
- 5 stars
- want purchasing to put them on preferred list
